name: Zhodani
description: A branch of Humaniti raised on Zhdant, the Zhodani have integrated psionics into every aspect of their society. Tall, lithe and predominantly dark-complexioned, they are governed by a Noble class of trained psions. Their society divides into three classes — Nobles (SOC 11+), Intendants (SOC 10) and Proles (SOC 9-) — with the boundary defined entirely by psionic ability.

characteristic_adjustments.description: If PSI 9+ and SOC 9-, raise SOC to 10 (Prole elevated to Intendant)
EDU cannot be higher than SOC; lower EDU to SOC value if greater
If EDU 7- and SOC 10+, increase EDU to 8

psionic_training_table.note: Nobles and Intendants undergo psionic training at the start of character creation. Each talent is attempted with a PSI check. Cumulative DM-1 per check attempted. On success, gain talent at level 0.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 1, Mongoose Publishing
